summary:
I validated SL-007 again at HEAD cc22a1e, scoped as stale: only CommandLine.cs and ReportFile.cs changed in src since 26b3952. I published the single-file Release exe into a scratch folder whose path has a space and drove it on this PC as an ordinary Medium-integrity account, through ProcessStartInfo, Start-Process and cmd /c. It ran on real scratch folders with real deny rules, on the real C:\ root, and with links planted mid-scan.

All 14 design cases hold on the shapes they name:
- The finish lines exit 0 with root `<tree>\` and the control's core (Completed, 20 files, 4 folders).
- The report for the two-space folder is written at the exact path.
- `"<tree>\"` alone keeps its window up.
- `"<tree>\" extra --report` exits 2 at 160 ms with no window.
- Deny CreateFiles exits 3 at 156 ms, a create-only drop folder exits 3 at 148 ms (it failed on my first pass), and `"C:\" --report C:\r.json` exits 3 at 152 ms. None opened a window or left a file.
- Links planted at `<report>.tmp` and at `<report>` leave the sentinel untouched.
- IN-M1's unpaired `<tree>\" --report <r>`, which hung on my first pass, now exits 0.

The whole suite passes (1448/1448), as do the bug project (7/7), Fitness (114 rules) and window cases C-007, C-008, C-012 and O-016 on a fresh publish.

One defect stays open in the tree: O-053, owed to build-slice. CommandLine.Arguments returns null for `"D:\Data\" --report "C:\out --old\r.json"` and for its class of report paths with a folder named `--...` after a space. On the published exe that line exits 2 at 146 ms, so a valid unattended report line is refused. That is why the verdict is partial, not passes.

criteria.criterion: 1. split: a quoted root ending in one backslash, followed by --report and a path, which Windows merges into one argument (`"D:\Data\" --report out.json`, `"C:\" --report C:\r.json`)
criteria.how: Ran CommandLine.Arguments from the built Core dll with argv from CommandLineToArgvW. Both lines give [root\, --report, path], and CommandLineTests is in the passing 1448. A report path quoted with a space before a `--` folder is outside this criterion's letter, because Windows splits it into two arguments. It is the open O-053.

criteria.criterion: 2. split: the root and a quoted report path both contain spaces, and the report path has a run of two spaces
criteria.how: `"D:\My Data\" --report "C:\out  dir\r.json"`: argv has 2 arguments, and the repair gives [D:\My Data\, --report, C:\out  dir\r.json] with both spaces kept. The spaced-root line `"D:\My Data\" --report "C:\Reports --2024\r.json"` gives null. That is O-053.

criteria.criterion: 3. split: a quoted root ending in a backslash with nothing after it (`"D:\Data\"`)
criteria.how: argv [D:\Data"] gives [D:\Data\] (args2.ps1). CommandLineTests.AQuotedRootEndingInABackslashAloneIsTheFolder passes in the suite.

criteria.criterion: 4. split: a line Windows split cleanly, with no '"' left in argv
criteria.how: `"D:\Data" --report out.json`, `"D:\Data\\" --report out.json` and `C:\ --report C:\r.json` come back unchanged (args2.ps1). CommandLineTests.ALineWindowsSplitCleanlyIsReturnedAsItCame passes.

criteria.criterion: 5. split: the typed line does not account for argv, so the alignment fails: an inner '"' gives null, and a trailing-only '"' gives argv unchanged
criteria.how: CommandLineTests.ALineThatDoesNotMatchItsArgvIsRefusedOrLeftAlone passes in the 1448-test suite. I built no mismatched line of my own.

criteria.criterion: 6. split: the grammar the new tokeniser opens (two \" in one line, odd run of three, tabs, quoted and unquoted argv0, empty quoted value, non-ASCII, UNC and \\?\, root last, corpus A01-A10 hand-quoted)
criteria.how:
CommandLineTests.TheGrammarTheRepairOpensIsSplitAsTyped and AppArgumentTests.EveryRootOfTheCorpusHandQuotedIsRepairedByArguments pass in the suite. I also measured two rows myself:
- `"D:\A\" --report "E:\out\"` gives [D:\A\, --report, E:\out\] (args2.ps1).
- An odd run of three on the published exe exits 0 with root <tree\\\>, the run kept whole as designed.

criteria.criterion: 7. unattended report: the exe started as `"<tree>\" --report "<file>"` (finish line 1)
criteria.how: Published single-file exe via psi, Start-Process and cmd /c: exit 0 in 726-818 ms, root <tree\>. The core matches the control (Completed, 20 files, 4 folders), and no temporary is left.

criteria.criterion: 8. unattended report: a spaced quoted root and a report path whose folder has two spaces (finish line 2)
criteria.how: Published exe via psi and Start-Process: exit 0 at 710 and 760 ms, root <tree sp\>, Completed, 20 files. The report is at the exact two-space path `\out  dir\l2.json`.

criteria.criterion: 9. open the window on a folder given at launch: `"<tree>\"` alone (finish line 3)
criteria.how: Published exe: the window appeared at 386 ms and the process was still running at 3030 ms. The bug project fact AQuotedRootEndingInABackslashAloneOpensTheWindow passes. I did not read which root the window shows.

criteria.criterion: 10. refuse a report line it cannot take: `"<tree>\" extra --report "<file>"` (finish line 4)
criteria.how: Published exe: exit 2 at 160 ms, no window seen, no report. The bug project fact passes in 144 ms.

criteria.criterion: 11. refuse a report path it cannot write: the folder exists but the account cannot create a file in it, as an ordinary user meets with `C:\ --report C:\r.json`
criteria.how:
Published exe, Medium-integrity account:
- Deny CreateFiles: exit 3 at 156 ms, no window.
- Create-only drop folder: exit 3 at 148 ms, no window, folder empty.
- `"C:\" --report C:\r.json` on the real C:\: exit 3 at 152 ms, no window, no C:\r.json, 0 .fsa-* entries.

criteria.criterion: 12. create the probe and the report's temporary: each open draws a name of its own at that moment, the probe leaves nothing, a failed move removes the temporary
criteria.how: ReportFileTests (AFreshStemIsDrawnForEachOpenAtTheMomentOfOpening, AProbeLeavesAWritableFolderAsItWas, AFailedMoveLeavesNoTemporary) and ReportFileDropFolderTests pass in the suite. None of 17 exe runs left a `.fsa-*` or `*.tmp` in any report folder. WindowCases C-008, C-012 and O-016 report 'no .tmp left'.

criteria.criterion: 13. no write through a planted link: a hardlink, file symlink or junction at the temporary's name; a hardlink or symlink at <report>; a hardlink at the old fixed <report>.tmp
criteria.how:
Plants made mid-scan on the published exe:
- Hardlink at r.json.tmp: exit 0, sentinel ORIGINAL.
- Hardlink at r.json: exit 0, sentinel ORIGINAL, single-link r.json.
- Dangling symlink at r.json: replaced, no target created.
On the exe a plant at the temporary's exact fresh name cannot be made, because the name is unpredictable. That case rests on ReportFileTests rows T01-T06 (stem injected), which pass in the suite. My raw CreateNew run also refused a file, a hardlink, a symlink, a junction and a directory symlink.

criteria.criterion: 14. no write through a planted link: a dangling symlink planted at the temporary's exact fresh name
criteria.how: Graded against the design, which decided this case as a residual (corpus row T07, expect 'residual', coveredBy E01). Raw CreateNew does follow a dangling symlink: I measured the target being created. What holds is that the name is drawn at the moment of opening and shown to nobody beforehand. ReportFileTests.AFreshStemIsDrawnForEachOpenAtTheMomentOfOpening and the E01 row show this, and both pass in the suite. On the exe a plant at the exact name cannot be made, because the name is unpredictable.

obligations.evidence:
The fix is not in the tree:
- tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/CommandLineDashFolderTests.cs does not exist.
- CommandLine.cs:94 still tests `argument.StartsWith("--", StringComparison.Ordinal)`.

Measured with the built Core dll and argv from CommandLineToArgvW:
- `"D:\Data\" --report "C:\out --old\r.json"` (argv [D:\Data" --report C:\out, --old\r.json]) gives NULL.
- `"D:\My Data\" --report "C:\Reports --2024\r.json"` gives NULL.
- So do `"C:\a --b --c\r.json"`, `"\\srv\share --x\r.json"` and `"C:\out --report\r.json"`.
- The neighbours `"C:\out -old\r.json"` (one dash) and `"C:\--x\r.json"` (no space before the dashes) repair correctly.

On the published exe, `"<tree>\" --report "<rep>\out --old\dash.json"` exits 2 at 146 ms with no report. The same line without the trailing backslash exits 0 at 848 ms (Completed, 20 files). So a valid unattended report line is refused, and the fix is owed to build-slice.

not_reached: Which root the interactive window actually shows for "<tree>\" alone. I saw only that a window opened and stayed up for 3 s; no UI was driven and no window state was read.
Whether base aa3d96b hangs on the O-053 dash-folder line. The base exe from my first pass is gone, so 'base opens a window' comes from reading the code, not from a run.

A real second account writing into the report's folder mid-scan (the SC-037 threat with a real other principal). All plants here were made by this same account, at the old fixed name and at <report>. The temporary's exact fresh name cannot be planted on the exe; that rests on unit rows with an injected stem.
A real create-only drop folder as found on a file server or set by another administrator. The shape was simulated with deny rules on a scratch folder.
Launch routes other than ProcessStartInfo, Start-Process and cmd /c: Task Scheduler, services, Explorer shortcuts, and the dotnet muxer (not launched).
Other Windows builds and ucrtbase versions. This PC runs Windows 11 10.0.26300, and the argv alignment was measured only here (N-065); not measurable on this machine.
WindowMutants NoCrashHandler and NoExitRule were not run. App.xaml.cs is unchanged this lap.
An elevated run of the shipped exe. It is out of scope and not on the named elevation list.
